headline: Conversion dropped everywhere in July, but we can't yet pin down why.
body: All four regions fell by nearly the same amount, so this isn't a one-region problem. Marketing spend and website traffic don't explain the drop. We haven't yet confirmed if the suspected warehouse delivery issue is the actual cause.
what_could_change: Direct evidence linking the North-West warehouse delays to customer conversion, or new data on customer complaints and competitor activity, would clarify the cause.
caveats: This is a broad, uniform decline with no confirmed root cause yet; acting without more evidence risks fixing the wrong problem.
clarifying_question: Do we have customer complaint or churn data tied to delivery delays that coincides with the conversion drop?
escalation_brief: Conversion rate fell sharply and uniformly across all regions in July with no confirmed cause; a suspected but unverified link to a North-West warehouse failure and enterprise customer defection needs urgent validation before any marketing spend decisions are made.
